items.title: Wendell Brunious interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: His dad had played piano, which was George Brunious’ cousin John, and his name was John Brunious also, my grandfather

ctx.x: Wow. Well I really don’t know a heck of a lot about how you got into this music, and I’d really enjoy finding out. I know your father was quite musical and a writer.

My dad was a great trumpet player. His dad had played piano, which was George Brunious’ cousin John, and his name was John Brunious also, my grandfather, he played kind of like piano and when my dad was about in second grade, Willie Humphrey — you know of him? The clarinet player? Willie Humphrey?
